meta.title: Required toggle on the question without reopening edit

steps.note: Open a multi-stage event creation flow for the RFP setup.
Provide the required event title before configuring the technical stage.
Configure the event with an RFP technical stage.
Work on the RFP stage where the question template is configured.
Apply the available RFP template containing the non-required question.
Load the technical questionnaire so the question and its Form View controls are present.

args.goal: On the RFP questionnaire's Form View, find the non-required question, switch on its Required toggle directly without opening the edit window, then open that question's Edit window and stop with Required showing Yes.

steps.note: Perform the required direct-toggle interaction and verify the edit view reflects the change.
Assert that the question edit view exposes the Required setting.
Assert that the Required setting is shown as Yes after the direct toggle.
